messages:
isabel.new: Hi all, I'm Isabel, new on infra team. Need Vault read for my service (staging) and a KMS key for encrypting backups. What's the onboarding flow?

tyler.devex: Welcome Isabel! :wave: Open a ticket in #platform-requests with the secret_request template and tag the service owner + security for prod KMS. Staging usually takes 1 day, prod ~2-3 after approvals.

leo.security: Quick checklist: 1) Vault paths must be per-env and narrow (no wildcards). 2) KMS CMKs require infra + security signoff if IAM bindings cross projects. 3) Prefer Vault dynamic DB creds; static secrets rotate every 90 days by default.

isabel.new: Got it. Can I get the template to paste into the ticket? Also, how do rotations actually execute?

tyler.devex: Template (paste into ticket):
```
secret_request:
  requester: isabel.new
  service: backup-agent
  envs: [staging, prod]
  vault_paths:
    - secret/data/backup-agent/staging: read
  kms_key: projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/backup/cryptoKeys/backup-cmk
  approver: @leo.security
  reason: encrypt backups + CI access
```

leo.security: Rotation: dynamic creds are automatic via TTLs. Static secrets: infra will schedule rotation every 90 days unless you request a different cadence and put an owner in the ticket. For emergency rotation open an incident and tag @security.

infra-bot: Ticket PR-2110 created. Assigned to infra-ops. ETA staging: 1 business day, prod: 3 business days.

vault-bot: policy "svc-backup-agent-staging" created and mounted at secret/data/backup-agent/staging (audit id: d4f8).

isabel.new: Thanks everyone  I'll file the ticket now and ping here if perms fail.
